title: Scorpio Opens One Window
old_caption:
Trust is built a little at a time.
You don't have to open the whole fortress on date three. Share one small true thing and see who shares back.

title: Sagittarius Said "Sometime"
old_caption:
Sag said "let's hang sometime" to eleven people.
The Sun made it pick a day. Now it's everyone's Thursday. Tag the friend whose sometime never comes.

title: Capricorn After the Promotion
old_caption:
"I'll date after the promotion," three years running.
Your heart isn't a five-year plan. Leave room for one dinner with friends this week, and close the laptop.

title: Aquarius Files a Bug Report
old_caption:
Aquarius filed a ticket: unexpected warmth when they text.
The Sun closed it as a crush. Status: working as intended. Ever tried to debug a feeling?

title: Pisces, Main Character
old_caption:
You hold everyone's heart. Who holds yours?
Cheering for your friends' love stories is beautiful. You deserve one too, and it starts with how you talk to yourself.

title: Aries, Try Waiting Five Seconds
old_caption:
One date in and Aries already had the 'so what are we' text loaded.
Uranus suggested a question instead, then five whole seconds of waiting. Who else is training for that record?

title: Taurus, Same Table, Third Year
old_caption:
Same booth, same order, year three, and neither of you wants to say it's a bit samey.
Keep the comfort and add one new thing. Ask what they've always wanted to try together.

title: Gemini, Forty Texts Deep
old_caption:
Gemini needed forty texts to explain one thought. Uranus suggested something wild: the call button.
The crush picked up laughing. Who is your friend that sends texts in bursts of ten?

title: Cancer, Hints Aren't Words
old_caption:
Baking, cleaning and sighing loudly so they'll notice you're hurt? Nobody can read a sigh.
Say it plainly and kindly: "I felt left out. Can we talk?" Most people want to know.

title: Leo, Let Them Plan It
old_caption:
Leo planned the light show, the speech and three outfit changes. Uranus had a better twist: let them do the spoiling.
Front row looks good on you, Leo. Who still needs to hand over the mic?
